metadataRaw.title: Back Leaning to One Side? Fix It in 60 SECONDS.
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates how to quickly fix a leaning or tilted back posture.

If you’re leaning or tilted to one side—especially due to back pain or a recent injury—this video is definitely worth checking out.

This issue is often caused by tight and weak muscles in the back that pull the spine out of alignment.

In this video, you’ll learn simple exercises designed to quickly release tension and strengthen key postural muscles, helping you achieve fast and long-lasting results. Many people notice improvement in as little as 60 seconds.

Watch now and fix a back that’s leaning to one side from the comfort of your home!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:30 Standing Exercise
2:13 Bed/Floor Exercise
3:48 Seated Exercise
5:08 Strengthening Exercise
7:20 Strengthening Exercise 2
8:59 BONUS EXERCISE
